title: Instant FPS Boost
description: This is a collection of optimization mods that increase your FPS by a lot, on any computer and on any server too
body:
This modpack is a collection of optimization mods that will improve your FPS significantly, no more dying because of lag, just smooth gameplay. 

It also includes some compatibility mods so you can easily install other fabric mods. 

From my testing, I went from 10-20 FPS without it and 105 FPS after adding these mods
All these mods are supported on your client so this pack can easily be used on any server without have to install these mods on the server. 

# List of Mods

## Optimization Mods
- Sodium
- Sodium Extra
- Lithium
- BadOptimizations
- Better Block Entities(BBE)
- ImmediatelyFast
- Clumps
- Concurrent Chunk Management Engine
- FerriteCore
- ModernFix-mVUS
- Dynamic FPS
- ScalableLux
- Entity View Distance
- EntityCulling
- More Culling
- Particle Core


## Compatibility Mods/Dependencies
- Architectury
- Cloth Config
- Entity Model Features
- Entity Texture Features
- Fabric API
- Fabric Language Kotlin
- Fzzy Config
- Placeholder API


## Mods that are nice to have
- Continuity
- FPS-Display
- Iris Shaders
- Mod Menu
